episode_summary: In this episode, Sarah Maslowski shares her strategies for maintaining a successful YouTube channel that has generated over $150 million in real estate sales. She emphasizes the importance of consistency, building a video bank, and having backup systems in place to ensure continuous content posting. Listeners will learn actionable tactics for content planning, filming, and managing video editors to enhance their real estate marketing efforts.
